title: Citizen 41mm Auto Promaster (Diver's 200M, Screw Down Crown) $249 Delivered @ StarBuy
body:
Deal: Citizen 41mm Auto Promaster (Diver's 200M, Screw Down Crown) $249 Delivered @ StarBuy

[Seymore] Looks nice. I've got a black dial promaster, but this is tempting
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Congrats WN
Banger piece for banger price
[CrypticM] Congratulations watchnerd. I really appreciate your commitment to post nice watch deals.
Good work.
[Lizard Spock] 41mm? That's hardly big enough for Australia''s no. 1 bargain site… Hehe, congrats man on your dedication to being a professional watchnerd.
[Nvu] Will the $25 off your first order work with this deal?
[GRP] So many watches that I stopped buying from Deepak who has done me a couple of good deals over the years. Thanks to WatchNerd and Deepak for adding another one to the collection and looking after all of us watch nerds.
[maverickjohn] Not a fan of the watch but great price. For whoever likes the design it's a great purchase
[starbearer] looking for a nice ecodrive, so will pass on this
[Darce Vader] Lovely watch, any chance of a further deal on any of the eco-drive promasters?
[Chazzozz] Nice post for your 200th, Watchnerd! I credit (blame?) your SB deals for tempting me into this hobby, so thank you for nudging me in the right direction. Also, enough can’t be said for Deepak’s dedication to this community, he’s been looking after us very well for many years.
[ocular] Good value. How accurate and stable is the movement? Have a Seiko 5 Sports SRPJ45K which is powered by the in-house Seiko Caliber 4R36. But am not impressed with it's accuracy - gains 1-2mins per day.
Is this to be expected for a non quartz movement?
[Wilburre] 8204 is a similar tier, maybe a bit more accurate but nothing to write home about.
-30/+45 is common for the 4R, 1 minute gain a day is reasonable, 2 is too much.
Try demagnetising otherwise it is what it is unless you want to pay to have it serviced.
[maverickjohn] Yep there is, particularly the evil type
https://www.hamiltonwatch.com/en-int/h35455730-american-clas…
[CityLoOK] bought one, although won't wear it, but what else can you buy for $250? 2 tank of petrol?
[Haunt] Wow absolute banger of a price there. If only I didn't have such tiny wrists :(
[WatchNerd] It's only 41mm. I think it would look good on you.
[Scrooge McDeal] Congrats!! Wow, looks awesome! It would look good on me. I wish they shipped in Europe.
